annotations.text:
The problem: the 7-day view is a CSS grid, so every day card stretches to the tallest in its row. Ten tasks on today leaves three empty cards the same height.

A one-line fix (items-start) stops the stretching, but the columns stay narrow and today still runs long.

My preference: Option A.

Today keeps a fixed, obvious place and gets the width to lay ten tasks out three abreast. Quiet days cost one line each but stay where you expect them.

Option B is shorter still, but a day stops being a fixed place on the page.
